text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaat, whyyyyyyy!?
Why the Satsuki Sho all of a sudden~!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I thought taking my time growing up was fine,
so why are you doing this, Traaainer?
choice_data_list: I thought testing our strength was necessary too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa, please don't test me like this.
I mean, this race issss...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!
At last, my grand stage has arrived.
Let us carve the youthful Overlord's hoofprints into the fresh greenery!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ayabe-san. Let's make today count.
Shall we dance together with grace?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have... that kind of luxury.
All I do is win.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You'll keep me company, won't you?
You want to enjoy this festival too, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer.
I just had a wonderful idea~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today's just practice! I don't really think I can win,
so I'll just run laps alongside Opera O-san and learn from her~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She walked off, wagging her tail.
Let's at least get her used to the atmosphere of the Triple Crown races."
